title: Roland Cross Mod and Metal Sync
summary: What Roland's "Cross Mod" and "Metal Sync" actually do on the Jupiter-8, Jupiter-6, MKS-80 and the later JX and Juno generations: which oscillator modulates which, how sync is combined with cross modulation, and what that means for the sound.

sources.title: Roland "Cross Mod" and "Metal Sync" – What do they actually do?
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
